verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly publish a system-to-system filing channel, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing Akamai and Incapsula bot walls on the front door and the ORION filing portal. It documents no system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or a published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
